basis: Offline multimodal review of a stratified Blood E*.MAP sample plus isolated ART previews. v1 over-trusts appearance for sky strips, the default tile, unused animation frames, and mixed-use fills.

rejected_distinctions.reason: A tile can be stone and still be a sky sheet, or metal and still be a masked separator. One class hides the useful split.
Gothic/industrial labels did not predict wall vs floor vs sky better than placement shares already do.
Almost no sampled wall is both a complete authored door face and moving-sector-associated. Tile 104, used as a scratch door in construction defaults, has only 2 corpus placements.
Sky/parallax is a ceiling rendering/placement fact. Indoor/outdoor is not independently evidenced by ART usage.
The stratified sample contained no verified damage-state tile runs. Native picanm families were liquid, wall, floor, or sprite loops, not wreckage sequences.

facets.label: placement kind
facets.basis: Sprite-only tiles (2520/2521) never appear on walls/floors; surface tiles almost never appear only as sprites.

facets.label: surface applicability
facets.basis: Tile 2500/3491/3678 are 64x400 and ceiling-only; 270/44 are floor-dominant; 110/5/80 are wall-dominant; 90/281 mix wall+floor.

facets.label: rendering behavior
facets.basis: Tile 330 is 560/560 masked overwalls; 1067 is often translucent hanging overlay. Opaque fill tiles have ~0 masked share.

facets.label: architectural role
facets.basis: Function split independently of stone/metal names: 330 fence separator, 1067 cobweb overlay, 195/93 thin strips, 2500 sky sheet, 1070 32x32 mechanism sprite, tile 0 default/placeholder.

facets.label: interaction role
facets.basis: Native picanm families 1029-1036 and 1100-1104 are animated surfaces. 1070 is sprite+mechanism on 28 maps. High moving_sector on adjacent walls is not enough to call a tile a door.

facets.label: scale behavior
facets.basis: Player-relative coverage: 110 tiles many times; 330/195 have tiny player_widths_per_repeat; 1067 sprite x-repeat is a discrete overlay instance.

facets.label: visual material
facets.basis: Useful for palette mood only. Does not predict placement: stone-looking 110 is a wall, stone-looking 2500 is sky, brown-noise 270 is a floor.
